status_at_registration: planned before new full-block intervals, views or query outcomes; original data and thinned case already inspected
origin: Retrospective diagnostic; not fresh confirmation, no new data or random seed.
target: Study-user-generating distribution under iid user blocks, not a general consumer population
assumptions: Users are iid study-user blocks; within-user items, sources and groups may be dependent.
Each source has a static binary potential rating vector; no panel-composition or order interference within source.

R selects a uniformly random 16-subset without replacement from all 300 items independently of its potential rating vector and independently across user blocks. This SRSWOR condition is declared, not established by released collector code.

O item-inclusion propensity is positive conditional on latent U and renders potential rating independent of inclusion given U; only outcome-conditional expected inverse inclusion weights are bounded by Lambda.
Fixed O24 independent uniform thinning preserves p and the outcome-conditional weight ratio, so original Lambda keeps its meaning. Full inclusion consistency is stronger than thinned consistency.
Group-only methods transport only ideal uniform group means within rho; full-cell controls additionally require static full-cell transport.
group_weights: uniform over the concrete items in each metadata category; overlapping partitions

observation_intervals.joint_denominator: N independent user blocks, not total events

randomized_group_intervals.score: Z_uj = sum of 1[rating>=4] among observed selected group items / M_uj, restricted to M_uj>0; zero ratings are missing, not successes or failures
randomized_group_intervals.independent_n: number of active users for the group
randomized_group_intervals.branch: CP if and only if fixed group size g=1, otherwise empirical Bernstein regardless of observed binary scores
randomized_group_intervals.eb: two-sided Maurer-Pontil: unbiased n-1 variance, log(4/delta), n<2 returns [0,1]

randomized_cell_intervals.construction: Two-sided CP per item from included users; all 300 fixed items
randomized_cell_intervals.projection: Only selected moments are transported; cell intervals are not placed on O in group-only methods

representation.matrix: Original 31x300 CSR matrix with exact same stored float entries
representation.kappa: g * Fraction.from_float(stored row coefficient w), without floating-point intermediate multiplication
representation.number_semantics: Registered rho and statistical CI endpoint floats interpreted as their exact binary64 rational values
representation.trusted_numerics: SciPy CP quantiles and empirical-Bernstein floating arithmetic are not made exact by the downstream proof checker

stronger_transport_controls: Full-panel R full-cell simultaneous CP once, alpha=.05/300 per item; static full-cell transport
Original all-16 direct R per-query Hoeffding control retained without change; N remains 290; not jointly calibrated for selected queries

hypothesis.descriptive_question: Does full-panel group fusion certify the original primary query at Lambda=2,rho=0,delta=.001 while both full-panel OBS and R-group standalones remain unresolved?
hypothesis.effect_threshold: a strictly positive verified lower bound above delta=.001 and neither standalone above delta; all other outcomes retained
hypothesis.statistical_test: No confirmatory hypothesis test or power claim. One reused real dataset has no known population truth. The 95% confidence-set statement is conditional on stated assumptions, not a measured coverage estimate.

stopping_rule: Exactly 12 declarations x 5 methods x 15 responses plus 15 full-cell controls. Retain all unresolved/refused outcomes. No feature, seed, radius, score or method selection based on results. Stop only on invalid input, unexpected exception or invalid proof, retaining partial record.
gate: Independent implementation PASS bound to this protocol and all imported local runtime source hashes before formal outcomes.
